Strange runes and pictographs, likely arcane in nature, have been scorched into the sides of this hide-covered strongbox.
Pull rope to spawn gladiator arena doors in the Well of Eru.
A black obelisk humming with a music you almost recognise. Touch it to enter the Hall of Legends.
A ledger of the great powers of Middle-earth currently lying slain, and when each is expected to walk again.

This Rod allows any number of buff spells to be cast as a single action.

To prime the rod, cast any spells you wish onto the rod to store them.

When activated, the rod fires all stored spells instantly on yourself.

A rod imbued with ancient knowledge. When activated and aimed at a player, the wielder rolls their Lore skill against each unidentified item in that player's inventory, instantly naming those within their ken.

The user and the target both receive a full report of what was identified — and what remains a mystery.

Prized by pack rats far and wide, Bags of Holding originated among the mischievous kender in the far-off world of Krynn. According to popular folklore, one enterprising kender actually founded a utopian village inside his Bag of Holding. It apparently continues to thrive to this very day.

A fine dwarven engraver's chisel, its edge etched with runes of true naming. Use it to inscribe a new name upon the weapon in your main hand: activate the chisel, then speak the new name aloud (in chat). Names may be at most 40 characters and may not contain the characters < or >. Say 'cancel' to change your mind. The chisel is consumed by a successful engraving.
